title: Parineeti Chopra on Love and Marriage with Raghav Chadha
description: Parineeti Chopra opened up about her relationship with Raghav Chadha, saying they have always viewed each other as friends and equals, keeping their careers, public identities and outside pressures separate from their private life. A psychotherapist and relationship coach explained that healthy relationships can suffer when professional success, income or social status creates an internal power hierarchy between partners. She noted that true equality is tested when circumstances change, such as career setbacks, parenthood or differences in earnings, and emphasised that couples should bring their work experiences home without bringing workplace hierarchies into the relationship. She also highlighted how ordinary, predictable moments can offer emotional security, stressing that a peaceful relationship does not mean a lack of passion and that healthy love does not need chaos to feel alive.
